title: Repeat-Change Multiplier — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit
content:
## Truth table — Specimen Collection Appointments

A late change to a home visit that has been moved before is multiplied by a repeat-change multiplier. Two records decide it: the number of times the visit has already been rescheduled (on the visit record), and how long the visit has been on the books — calendar days from the visit's booking date to today.

| Already moved at least once | Booked 7 or more calendar days before today | Charge multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 1.25 |
| Yes | No (fewer than 7 days) | 1.50 |
| No (never moved) | Yes | Taken as it stands |
| No (never moved) | No | Taken as it stands |

**Clause.** When the visit has already been moved at least once and it was booked 7 or more calendar days before today, the charge is multiplied by 1.25; when it has already been moved at least once and it was booked fewer than 7 days before today, the charge is multiplied by 1.50; when the visit has never been moved, the charge is taken as it stands.

### Edges (hypothetical Mobile In-Home Collection Visits, moved once before)

- Booked exactly 7 days before today: 1.25.
- Booked 6 days before today: 1.50.
- A visit never moved, booked 2 days before today: taken as it stands.
